g.text: › Once upon a time, in a small village
called Dernholm, there lived a small hamlet called Anderst. The people of Dernholm were friendly and
kind. They had a few things to teach. One of these was the art of building a boat. They had a special
boat made for the occasion, and they put it in the river.
when they got out of the boat, they saw that the water was too deep for them to go to the other side.
They had to make a raft. The villagers offered to help, but they refused. So the villagers made their
own raft. They put a rope around the boat and fastened it to the end
